digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate (LLM agent tool loop control)
propositions: Completion verifier trips RunawayToolLoopError during re-reads of memoized evidence files, blocking legitimate closes despite prior runaway-guard fix.

The runaway guard (outermost layer) counts memo-served repeats as loop evidence before the memo layer can serve them cache-free, making guards and memo fight each other and defeating the purpose of the memo's path-normalized cache.
The runaway guard must be recomposed with the memo layer via a shared ToolCallLedger that records only EXECUTED work, not memo-served calls, so the distinct-ratio arm trips only on genuine loops.
A pure cache-served loop (zero execution for a full guard window) must still be bounded by a served-streak backstop arm, distinguishable from ratio-arm trips.
Layer order (Guard→Memo→Steering) and completion-policy visibility must remain unchanged during the recomposition fix.
